findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed an insect glue trap stored in very close contact with a stack of clean pans (in cabinet across from triple sink). Shown to the PIC and the trap was discarded to correct the violation. Ensure that insect traps are never stored in areas where food or food contact surfaces can be exposed to contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-202.13 Insect Control Devices, Design and Installation. (A) Insect control devices that are used to electrocute or stun flying insects shall be designed to retain the insect within the device. (B) Insect control devices shall be installed so that: (1) The devices are not located over a FOOD preparation area; and (2) Dead insects and insect fragments are prevented from being impelled onto or falling on exposed FOOD; clean EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, and LINENS; and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.
